scope: Nine-route synthetic public site, Russian CMS and local placement-preparation runtime

resolved_findings.summary: Locale-dependent CMS timestamp caused hydration divergence.
resolved_findings.resolution: Deterministic UTC formatting; runtime recheck passed.

resolved_findings.summary: Medium-width direction cards changed density abruptly.
resolved_findings.resolution: Container-aware auto-fit grid; 54-state overflow recheck passed.

resolved_findings.summary: Global navigation was labelled as in-page navigation.
resolved_findings.resolution: Accessible name changed to Основные разделы on every page.

resolved_findings.summary: The framework redirected the standard robots path because of trailing-slash policy.
resolved_findings.resolution: Worker now returns direct robots.txt HTTP 200 on both path variants.

resolved_findings.summary: A failed first D1 initialization could pin a rejected promise for the worker isolate.
resolved_findings.resolution: Rejected initialization is removed from the WeakMap and may retry safely.

resolved_findings.summary: Predelivery responses did not explicitly forbid caching.
resolved_findings.resolution: Global no-store boundary added and tested.
